newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Astra rises over 3 pct on Investor talk.
newsitem.headline: Astra rises over 3 pct on Investor talk.

text.p: Swedish drugs major Astra AB rose over three percent on Thursday morning to a new high, fuelled by rumours that investment company Investor AB has sold its stake in the company.
At 1015 GMT Astra shares were 10.5 crowns higher at 338 crowns after reaching 339 crowns, a record high.
Investor spokesman Nils Ingvar Lundin declined to comment on the rumours that the investment company had sold its Astra stake at a premium.
"If we make a change in our portfolio of a size that we must announce, then we will do that," he told Reuters.

Lundin said Investor's last comment on its Astra stake were made by chief executive Claes Dahlback at a press conference on September 18 when he said the company's longterm view was to lift its Astra stake.
As of October 18 this year, Investor held 10.0 percent of Astra's capital.
